reason: Revised per REV-20260928-19: the primary contrast is now fixed-candidate (same 10 parent artifacts, per-parent token matching), recall equivalence has a plus or minus 3 point test, the negative verdict needs a one-sided 95% bound below the 3-point margin, prompt attribution is corrected, B5 is dropped to a related measurement, and the packet gains a start gate, numeric token estimate (about 18M) and cap enforcement. It can move B16 (lead) on raw versus distilled evidence for engineering artifacts and settles the ingestion write-path choice before Track B freezes its benchmark set.
